trust_decision.summary: Header field values parsed by detail::parse_header are passed to the callback as opaque octets after an is_field_value check; at the pinned commit they are no longer percent-decoded (the real fix fbb031e is already an ancestor of the pinned commit), so the flaw is absent from the pinned tree.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names server-side parse_header percent-decoding header values; parse_header is the only function of that name.

fix_sites.module_kind: version constant, not a security change

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the pinned tree already contains the fix, so there is nothing to dismiss or repair.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multipart Content-Disposition filename* (RFC 5987) is still legitimately percent-decoded; an over-broad 'never decode anything in headers' change would break it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Request/response header reader callback re-decoding the value before emplacing into Headers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second caller of parse_header; a maintainer could have kept decoding here for legacy app compatibility.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Multipart part-header callback decoding values into file_.headers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file already decodes filename* nearby (httplib.h:7976), so decoding the whole part-header value would look consistent.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Trailer callback decoding values before dest.emplace
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Trailers are merged into headers through a separate path a maintainer could forget when removing decoding.

O9_family: HTTP header CRLF injection / parser differential via percent-decoding of header values (CWE-93, CWE-444)

O10_build.project_tests: test/test.cc:7444 ServerRequestParsingTest.HeaderValueNotPercentDecoded and test/test.cc:7530 RefererWithPercentEncodedNewline already present at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject %0D/%0A in header values instead of dropping decoding (already moot at the pinned commit).

out_of_scope_notes: Listed fix commit 811dd0b is the v0.44.0 release bump; the security change is fbb031e ('Stop percent-decoding HTTP request header values'), which is already in the pinned commit's history. To be usable the candidate would have to be re-pinned at fbb031e^ and re-screened.
